composition_contract.callbacks: Five named supplied handlers. Function code/capture identities are outside value-state proof; presence, labels, effects and ordered events are retained.
composition_contract.equality: Two fresh same-role replicas compare every complete trace. Opposite endpoint transport is independently tested by native anchors.
composition_contract.failures: Authored first-error latch retains partial state and innermost World phase; later mutating calls refuse. Native resource and API-refusal limits are independently hand-tested, not attributed to Python.
composition_contract.ordering: Before each nonpending original Machine.tick(1), assign World.frame and sim_frame from net_frame. This explicit extension is supported by the separately pinned observed mainloop document, not an invented frame increment.
composition_contract.pads: Import current three network pad words at each outer World scope; nested scopes retain mutations. Publish pads, World.frame and shared seed on normal and exceptional exit.
composition_contract.seeds: World.shared and net.rand_seed share an explicitly mapped domain. Combat seed is independent and never drawn in these cases.
composition_contract.snapshot: Self-contained authored serializer; complete graph represented by reconstructible default pool/cell layout and all nondefault links, identities and values. Per-step primitive snapshots are deep copies.
composition_contract.tasks: Fresh World, runObjects priority10 only; authored registered pre/post/draw/late tasks. World.tasks_run(1) calls pinned run_objects, with no renderer or World.init.

scope: Authored RTA Session ownership adapter for pinned object and network models. No game-native implementations, rendering, original-client networking, Norrath parity or playable-world claim.
